'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Rops'''. Username '''Blay.''. L41 WIAPN → We're In Attack Position Now. L46 MM + Endor Celeb → Masterful Move & Endor Occupation. Shield5 Code Clearance → Do They Have A Code Clearance? (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' Blay.
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
